packages.title: Day Trip to Nyerere National Park
packages.summary: This 1 Day Trip to Nyerere National Park formerly (Selous Game Reserve) a Tanzania’s iconic and beautiful National Park, one of the few Protected Areas in the country’s southern circuit. Surrounded by Udzungwa Mountains National Park in the west as well as Mikumi National Park in the northwest, explore this awesome safari destination in all its glory with a game drive. It has significant populations of the African elephant, black rhinos and wild hunting dogs. It also includes one of the world’s largest known populations of hippopotamus and buffalo.

itinerary.title: Dar es Salaam – Nyerere National Park (Selous Game Reserve)
itinerary.summary: Pick up from your hotel in Dar es Salaam in the morning and proceed to Nyerere National Park with picnic lunch, Late afternoon, boat safari along the mighty Rufiji River, Dinner and overnight at Lodge / Tented Camp (L,D). Rufiji River by boat, encounter hippos and crocodiles in good numbers. Some 350 bird species have been recorded in the Selous Game Reserve. These are typical of miombo woodlands, and the bird life supported by Rufiji swamplands is of particular interest.

itinerary.title: Game Drive in Nyerere National Park – Dar es Salaam
itinerary.summary: After early breakfast, proceed for game drive with picnic lunch. Afternoon, proceed for Dar es Salaam. Arrive around 1800 hours or later depending on traffic.

itinerary.title: Full day Game Drives in Nyerere National Park (Selous Game Reserves)
itinerary.summary: After early breakfast depart for full day game drive in the Selous Game Reserve exploring the game in the surrounding areas. You may expect to see any of the major African great favorite mammals, including Elephant, Giraffes, Lions, Buffalo, Zebra and even the rare African Wild Dog. Picnic lunch shall be provided in the mid-day and afternoon return to the lodge and the rest of the evening will be spent at your own leisure. Dinner and overnight at Lodge/ Camp.

itinerary.title: Nyerere National Park Walking Safari – Dar es Salaam / Zanzibar
itinerary.summary: Early morning walking safari into the Nyerere National Park, usually start at 6-6.30am after early morning tea or coffee, accompanied by an armed ranger and it will take around 2-3 hours long. Walking safari is a fantastic way to experience more about the Selous Bushes. Although you may see wildlife during the walk, the focus is also on the habitat that the animals live in, insects, trees and birdlife. You will have an interesting and amazing experience to walk within such a vast area of the natural reserve – an experience which very few places in Africa are able to offer. After breakfast you will be transferred to Mtemere airstrip for the departure on a scheduled night at 1030hrs or 1250hrs to Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar.

packages.title: 2 Days Safari to Katavi National Park
packages.summary: This 2 Days Katavi National Park Safari will take you to the far west of Tanzania in Tanzania’s lesser-known Katavi National Park which is extremely remote and an untouched wilderness that will give you a unique encounter experience with Game.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Katavi National Park
itinerary.summary: Early morning you will be picked up from the hotel in Mpanda town (fly into Mpanda a the day before) for the journey to Katavi National Park, driving through beautiful the setting of amazing landscapes with picnic lunch upon arrival in the park, you will go for a Game drive in the park to spot quite a number of animals till late evening hours and later head to your booked accommodation for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Game Drive in Katavi National Park and Departure
itinerary.summary: After having warm morning breakfast, you will head out for Morning game drive, look out for animals such as cape buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, giraffes, elephants, cheetahs, wild dogs, hyenas, leopards, jackals, and pride of lions among others, in the afternoon you will go for a short game drive along the Katavi flood plains to watch hippos and crocodiles as well as more animals and birds that congregate at the remaining pools of Katuma River. Evening you will be driven back to Mpanda town to where you will be dropped off at the hotel or fly back to Arusha or Dar es Salaam

itinerary.title: Transfer to Katavi National Park
itinerary.summary: You will begin your safari with a morning flight from either Dar es Salaam or Arusha with a charter flight heading to Katavi National Park, and upon landing at Mpanda airstrip, you will be transferred to the park using a vehicle, lunch at your booked accommodation and then you will go for a short game drive to spot some animals in the park, dinner, and overnight at your booked lodge.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive in Katavi National Park
itinerary.summary: After breakfast, you will head out for morning game drive or walking safari if booked in the safari plan, and while in the park along the Katavi flood plains you will look out for animals such as cape buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, giraffes, elephants, cheetahs, wild dogs, hyenas, leopards, jackals and pride of lions among others, return for lunch in the afternoon you will go for a game drive the palm-fringed Lake Chada in the South - East, and Katuma River, with a picnic lunch you will have a chance to see the greatest population of Crocodile and Hippos, Lion and Leopard looking for prey among the huge population of herbivorous e.g. Impala, Eland, Topi, Zebra, and many more. Return in the evening dinner and overnight at Camp/Lodge. Meal Plans; Breakfast, Lunch

itinerary.title: Departure to Dar es Salaam / Arusha
itinerary.summary: After morning breakfast at the lodge/camp, you will be transferred to the airstrip for your scheduled flight to Dar es Salaam/Arusha to the international airports for departure back home or to your hotel making it the end of your safari.
